name: @monoes/memory
description: Memory module - JSON pattern store, SQLite + embeddings backend, and a standalone pure-JS HNSW index; not a single unified backend

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && node --input-type=module --eval "import('./dist/index.js').then(m => { const required = ['SQLiteBackend','SqlJsBackend','HNSWIndex','CacheManager','QueryBuilder','SwarmCheckpointer']; const missing = required.filter(k => !m[k]); if (missing.length) { console.error('Missing exports:', missing); process.exit(1); } console.log('All required exports present'); });"
